title: Introducing the Luel data platform | Luel
summary: Buy and sell datasets through your agent or the console, starting with 5 rights-cleared conversational speech datasets.
body_markdown:
Today we're launching the Luel Data Platform: a place to buy and sell datasets through your agent or from the console. Browse and license data over MCP, or submit your own dataset for review and listing.


The platform opens with 5 consented conversational speech datasets, with more speech corpora and multimodal datasets coming soon. It brings the data our contributor network creates into the workflows where people are already building.


## Buy datasets with your agent


Ask your agent to browse the catalogue and license a dataset. Luel Data works over MCP with **Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients** , making dataset discovery and licensing part of the same workflow as the rest of your project.


Authenticate in your browser. No API keys to copy or paste. You can also browse and license directly from the console; both routes give you access to the catalogue.


## The data underneath


The data comes from **Luel's network of more than 850,000 contributors across 96+ countries** . That reach lets us collect real speech from the communities that use each language, and bring it into a catalogue that people and their agents can license.


The speech available at launch is cleared and licensed for commercial AI training. Adults we pay, who agreed their recordings can train AI. Collected from real people, never synthetically generated. Integrity-checked before delivery.


## Have data to sell?


Turn high-quality datasets into licensable inventory. Submit through your agent or the console; Luel handles review and QA before your dataset goes live. You can check its status at any time.


That opens the platform to people and organisations with data to offer, alongside the catalogue available to buyers. The same agent workflow supports both sides: finding data for your project and submitting data for others to license.


## Where this goes next


The Luel Data Platform is public today. The research and specialist models built around real-world data continue at[Luel Labs](https://www.luel.ai/lab) and[Luel Speech](https://www.luel.ai/speech) .
